But benefits were allowed and so companies started offering health insurance and tax code allows it pretax. And that system of employer provided insurance has just grown over the last 60+ years. 

FSAs are for medical items. Health insurance isn't considered a medical item. You're also in an odd situation. Normally people with access to an FSA would also have employer provided insurance that was already pretax. 

Technically you can still deduct it, but you have to itemize your taxes *AND* you can only deduct the amount that's 10% over your AGI>.
